card.name: Hyphen before p in joined words
card.fires_on: The hyphen-plus-p piece ("-p") that splits a compound after a first word, as in proton-pump, liquid-powder, pre-papal. The following letters are then completed by the rest of the word.

modes.label: Proton-pump inhibitor
modes.description: The hyphen-p piece inside the drug class name proton pump inhibitor.

modes.label: Other hyphenated compounds
modes.description: A hyphen-p piece joining two nouns or a prefix and a word, such as liquid-powder or tomato-poor.
